_comment: Source of the README 'See it work' block (scripts/docs/sync_docs.py, block `recordings`). Edit captions here, never in README.md. `featured` clips are GIFs shown inline; every take is an MP4 with a poster. scripts/record/refresh.sh rebuilds the files under the same names.
note: Recorded on the real backend with the real 2026 workbooks. Instructor names are reduced to initials.

featured.title: Reserve a free period
featured.caption: Point at a free period, click, confirm. The cell then shows You.

featured.title: Book several periods
featured.caption: Drag across free periods of one room. One sheet books them together.

featured.title: Find a room
featured.caption: Head count and a feature. Rooms that fit come first, near fits after, each with its reason.

featured.title: Undo from the audit log
featured.caption: A move shows the room before and after. Undo puts it back.

featured.title: Move a class
featured.caption: Only free rooms that fit are offered. The server checks the move before it is saved.

featured.title: Pre-check and fix
featured.caption: The Studio checks the plan against the term's data and applies one of its fixes.

featured.title: Start from an empty instance
featured.caption: Drop the exam workbook with AI off. It is read, a term is proposed, reviewed and saved.

takes.title: Reservation panel: a click, a drag, room details
Move a class in the calendar, then undo
Studio: a rule from a template, the pre-check and a fix
Book a room with a note, My bookings
Create an account and pick its role
Run report: apply a suggested fix
